_meta: Per-platform image generation spec. Used by image-overflow-detection-gate for static char limits and by template generators for safe zone constraints. Updated 2026-05-15.

linkedin_post.notes: LinkedIn OG card. Aspect ratio 1.91:1. At 62px Arial, ~20 chars/line in 900px max-width = 3 safe lines max before hitting subtitle row.

linkedin_article_cover.notes: LinkedIn Article header image. Rendered as cover photo. No text overlay needed — headline is set in article title field in LinkedIn UI.

x_card.notes: Twitter/X summary_large_image card. Same OG dims as LinkedIn post.

instagram_square.notes: Instagram carousel slide. 1:1 square. At 72px Arial, ~18 chars/line in 888px. With top/bottom chrome rows consuming ~240px, headline gets ~640px = ~4 lines max. OVERFLOW HOT ZONE — use line breaks in h1 and keep font at 72px not 78px.

instagram_story.notes: Instagram Story. 9:16 tall format. More usable height so overflow less common, but bottom 250px is gestures/UI area — keep content above it.

substack_cover.notes: Substack post cover. 2:1 ratio. Appears as email header and post thumbnail in feed.
